messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: prod continuous-batching pool 'cb-main' - 99thpct token latency spike and queue growth detected (since 2143654200). Errors increased ~9% and queue depth up 3.2x. Auto-page sent to #eng-oncall and on-call schedule.

alex (oncall): acked. looking. is this affecting user-facing requests or internal eval jobs? severity? @priya can you pull impact metrics?

priya (eng-sre): doing a quick rollup now. preliminary: 5m error rate +11%, 95p latency +120%, 99p latency +350%. Most errors are `batch_overflow`/429 from the batching controller + some KV cache misses causing txn retries. customers with high concurrency (burst clients) see degraded responses.

sam (runtime): I can see continuous-batch backlog on cb-main hosts. microbatch sizes ballooning to 48-64 in some shards due to jitter in the inflight estimator. That increases kv-cache pressure (hotset eviction), leading to lots of KV reloads.

maria (ml-infra): kv cache eviction logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:01:10Z cb-main-7 evict: shard=12 freed=1.8MB reason=pressure
2026-03-15T21:01:11Z cb-main-3 reload: key=kv-... latency=12ms
2026-03-15T21:01:12Z cb-main-3 evict: cascade=true freed=10MB
```
Looks like cascade evictions across nodes.

alex (oncall): customer impact = tail latency increases, some 429s. set severity P1? @ryan what are support flags? any open tickets high priority?

ryan (support): we have two customers reporting timeouts on endpoints that use large context windows. Marked Sev2 so far, ready to escalate if we see sustained 5xxs. I'd keep customers informed.

priya (eng-sre): mitigation plan suggestion: 1) reduce max_microbatch_size on cb-main from 64 -> 8 (hot-config) to limit batch amplification; 2) enable microbatch jitter smoothing flag to avoid bursts; 3) temporarily lower prefix KV cache TTL for non-critical models to avoid cascade. That should reduce queueing and give time for a proper rollout.

sam (runtime): I can push a hotfix to the configmap and trigger a rolling config push to cb-main nodes. quick command I plan to run:```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap/redwood-runtime-cb --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/max_microbatch_size","value":"8"}]'
# then trigger on nodes:
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/redwood-runtime --selector=pool=cb-main --grace-period=20
```
I'll dry-run on one shard first.

alex (oncall): do it. @pagerduty-bot please annotate incident with mitigation step.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 86321 annotated: "hotfix: max_microbatch_size=8 rollout started by sam"

[some minutes later]

sam (runtime): patched and rolled out to 20% of cb-main pods. Observing immediate drop in queue depth and 95p latency down ~35%. No increase in errors so far.

maria (ml-infra): also applied temporary KV TTL reduction for non-critical models: `kv_prefix_ttl=60s` for batch-models group. This cut cross-shard reload rate by ~60% in the canary cluster.

priya (eng-sre): metrics look better cluster-wide after 12m: queue depth back to baseline, 99p latency down ~210ms, errors down to +2%. Recommend continue gradual rollout to 100% and monitor for regressions.

ryan (support): drafting customer note: "We're investigating an infrastructure-induced latency increase affecting high-concurrency requests. We've rolled an immediate fix that reduces batching amplification; you may see improved latency over the next 15 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and long-term mitigations." Want to post?

alex (oncall): yes post it in affected-customer channels. Add ETA for RCA by EOD.

sam (runtime): rolling out to remaining 80% now. Will watch for microbatch jitter reappearing.

[10m later]

sam (runtime): full rollout complete. system indicators: queue depth normalized, kv eviction events down, token throughput stable. No new 5xx spikes.

priya (eng-sre): demote severity to P2 and close the active page after handoff. Create followup ticket for root cause analysis: investigate inflight estimator oscillation and add stronger smoothing and backpressure heuristics.

alex (oncall): creating followup: TKT-3197: "continuous-batching microbatch oscillation -> perf cliff at high concurrency" assigned to sam + maria. Also include runbook update to add emergency hotfix steps.

ryan (support): posted customer note and pinged affected accounts. Customers acknowledge improvement.

alex (oncall): handing off to next on-call @sam for monitoring/cleanup. I'll be available for communication with support/execs. Handoff notes: hotfix applied (max_microbatch_size=8), kv_prefix_ttl ramped for non-critical models, full rollout complete, monitoring alerts lowered.

sam (runtime): taking over. I'll keep the bridge open for another 30m and then close if stable. Adding a watch dashboard and an alert if queue depth climbs >1.5x baseline.

alex (oncall): thanks team :thumbsup: closing page.

pagerduty-bot: Incident 86321 acknowledged by alex (oncall), reassigned to sam (runtime)."
